findings.quote: E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen sind ausgeschaltet, bis Sie sie aktivieren.
findings.rationale: This says email notifications remain disabled until activated, contradicting the verified default of enabled when no preference exists. Update the wording to describe enabled-by-default behavior while preserving explicit opt-out.
This assertion retains the old default. Running the check fails because the helper now returns true. Change this expectation to true and retain the explicit-false assertion, which remains correct.

limitations: Six artifacts were deeply investigated; remaining inventory entries were scanned only. Translation guidance, mandatory security messages, and theme preferences concern separate behavior.
